Sales Executive Job at Runofeeds Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Runofeeds Nigeria Limited is a poultry feed production company committed to providing high-quality and nutritionally balanced feed to poultry farmers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive

Job Location: Asaba, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	We are seeking a results-driven Sales Executive to expand our market reach and strengthen relationships with poultry farmers and distributors.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Promote and sell Runofeeds poultry feed products to poultry farmers, distributors, and agro-dealers.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and farming communities.
	Provide basic product guidance and support to farmers on the use of poultry feeds.
	Organize farmers’ forums, field visits, and training sessions in partnership with industry bodies such as Poultry Association of Nigeria.
	Identify new sales opportunities and expand the company’s customer base.
	Prepare sales reports and provide market feedback to management.


Requirements


	Minimum of an HND/B.Sc. in Animal Science, Animal Production, Agriculture, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on sales experience, preferably in poultry feeds or agricultural products.
	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Valid driver’s licens eand willingness to travel for field sales.


Compensation


	Salary Range: N200,000 – N300,000 (based on experience).
	Housing allowance / relocation support may be provided.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Sales Executive-Runofeeds" as the subject of the email.

Senior Project Manager Job at Harmony Garden & Estate Development Limited




        
    

        
        Harmony Garden & Estate Development Limited is a pioneering real estate and construction firm committed to innovation, sustainability, and excellence. We are working to utilizes innovative technologies to enhance the sustainability, sales and efficiency of building projects. 

As a leading real estate company specializing in the sale of land with genuine titles, luxury property development, and farm city settlements, Harmony Gardens is synonymous with integrity, quality, and exceptional service. With 1,300 hectares of genuine land valued at $215 million USD and investments across multiple sister businesses—including Royal Crystal Airways, BMTC Energy, and Ibile Industrial Park—we are well-positioned for significant growth.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:
 Job Position: Senior Project Manager
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	This role requires a hands-on leader who can drive productivity, solve technical challenges, and maintain strict compliance with quality, safety, and project timelines.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate the execution of construction projects by contractors and site teams.
	Monitor daily construction activities to ensure timely project delivery and proper documentation.
	Identify, manage, and resolve technical issues and construction snags within approved timelines.
	Monitor material issuance and minimize material wastage.
	Review contractors' work progress and provide regular updates and recommendations to the Construction Project Manager.
	Plan and coordinate workforce scheduling, deployment, and productivity.
	Ensure timely availability of construction materials to prevent project delays.
	Monitor compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
	Conduct daily site inspections to ensure quality workmanship, housekeeping, and site organization.
	Prepare and submit accurate daily and weekly project progress reports.
	Coordinate contractors, artisans, suppliers, and vendors to achieve project milestones.
	Support the Construction Project Manager in project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
	Ensure strict compliance with Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) policies across all project sites.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Project milestone achievement: ≥95%
	Snag resolution completed within 3 working days
	Material wastage maintained below 5%
	Daily site inspection compliance: 100%
	Workforce productivity: ≥90%
	Material availability: 100%
	Weekly reporting compliance: 100%
	Contractor performance: ≥90%
	Quality compliance: 100%
	Safety compliance: 100%.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 7 years of post-qualification experience in construction project execution.
	Registration with the Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) is required.
	Membership of the Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) is required.
	Proven experience managing contractors, site operations, and construction teams.
	Strong understanding of construction methods, project scheduling, quality control, and HSE requirements.
	Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities across project sites.


Core Competencies:


	Construction Site Management
	Project Execution & Coordination
	Contractor Management
	Workforce Planning & Supervision
	Quality Assurance & Quality Control
	Material Management
	Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance
	Technical Problem Solving
	Reporting & Documentation
	Leadership & Team Management.


Salary
N400,000 - N500,000 per month.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Cashier / Inventory Officer",
  "description": "Salpha Energy is a renewable energy company determined to provide affordable solar solutions for everyone. We are addressing the huge market need for energy by enabling people harness the infinite source of light that freely accessible to everyone.

Innovations in renewable technology afford us the opportunity to place power back in the hands of people, through innovative and quality conscious products that are built to last for outdoor campaing, entrepreneurial activities, rural settlements or disaster relief.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Cashier / Inventory Officer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview


	As the Cashier/Inventory Officer, you play a dual role in managing both cash transactions and inventory control at the branch or outlet level.
	You would ensure accuracy in financial dealings, transparency in stock movement, and accountability for all cash and product-related activities.
	Your position is critical to maintaining operational efficiency, preventing losses, and supporting the company&rsquo;s goal and objectives by facilitating financial transactions and sales through dealers and partnership operations.


Key Responsibilities
Cash Management:


	Receive payments (cash, POS, transfers) from customers and issue receipts accurately.
	Record all daily financial transactions in the approved system (on the location&rsquo;s drive and sheets) and ensure reconciliation at close of business.
	Maintain accurate record of all transactions within the outlet for both dealership and partner&rsquo;s sales.
	Maintain accurate record of all expenses within the branch office with accompanying evidence/document.
	Monitor transactions with partners (LAPO &amp; Grooming), ensuring all sales are supported with valid and error free documentation.
	Maintain confidentiality and integrity in handling company funds and client financial data.
	Track sales transactions and report any discrepancies to the management.


Inventory Management:


	Maintain accurate records of all stock received, issued, transferred, or sold at the outlet.
	Conduct physical stock counts and reconcile discrepancies with the system or stock register/sheet maintained on the drive.
	Ensure all product movements (inbound and outbound) are properly documented with SIV (signed delivery notes, stock issue forms, or transfer forms).
	Work closely with the sales, logistics and warehouse team to update stock balances in real-time.
	Monitor inventory levels and raise timely replenishment requests to avoid stockouts.
	Ensure the storage area is clean, organized, and compliant with safety and product preservation standards.
	Track defective or returned products and ensure proper documentation for repairs or warranty processing.
	Work with the sales and engineering team to ensure all defectives are prompting repaired and returned to the customer.
	Escalate any financial, sales or stock irregularities immediately to the Account team lead and management.
	Track sales order and supplies to partners to confirm quatity ordered versus quality supplied.


Other Important Functions:


	Conduct reconciliation for LAPO before product disbursement.
	Maintain up-to-date records of all sales and inventory transactions for audit purposes.
	Provide courteous and efficient service to walk-in customers, dealers, and partner representatives.
	Collaborate with the Partnership financial accountant to validate payment for disbursement made.
	Adhere and ensure full compliance of all company&rsquo;s financial policies within the outlet.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an HND / Bachelor`s Degree with 2 - 4 years of experience.


Key Qualities Expected:


	Appearance and dress: The Cashier/Inventory Officer will be clean and neatly attired while on duty in a manner befitting of your position.
	Teamwork &ndash; Ability to work within a diverse team (SOs, PIDOs, Technicians, partner reps etc) with the aim of actualizing organizational goal above personal gains.
	An eye for details.
	Computer Literate and continuous up skilling.
	Good knowledge of Inventory Management.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines.
	Result and service orientation.
	Ability to multi-task effectively.


Core Values Alignment:


	Integrity: Uphold transparency and accountability in all dealings.
	Customer Focus: Ensure prompt, polite, and professional service.
	Discipline: Adhere strictly to financial and operational policies.
	Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with sales, finance, Engineering and logistics teams.


Benefits


	Salary: N100,000 monthly.
	We offer a captivating and varied function with an organization driven by its mission and where initiative, creativity, and energy are strongly encouraged.
	Competitive remuneration aligned with industry standards.
	Opportunity to work in a mission-driven, high-impact organization in the renewable energy space.
	Exposure to a multicultural, dynamic work environment.
	Professional growth opportunities across communications, partnerships, strategy and leadership.
	A supportive, collaborative team culture that encourages creativity, innovation, and ownership.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: salpha@salphaenergy.com using &quot;Cashier/Inventory Officer, Port Harcourt&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Warehouse Officer (Male) Job at BerryMart Integrated Services Limited




        
    

        
        BerryMart Integrated Services Limited - We are an award-winning Distributor of Confectionaries in Africa established in 2010 to serve wholesale, Retailers and in market distributors.

In the past 15 years we have successfully established our position as a major player in the wholesale and retail business in Nigeria, we pride ourselves on the excellent service we provide while focusing on excellent customer services and value for money.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Warehouse Officer (Male)

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos

Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Warehouse Officer to oversee daily inventory operations, manage stock movement, and ensure smooth logistics execution.
	Handle receiving, dispatching, record-keeping, and maintain warehouse organization


Key Responsibilities


	Receive, inspect, organize stock for optimal space utilization and quick access.
	Prepare orders for delivery, coordinate with delivery team, and ensure accurate order picking, packing, and labeling.
	Maintain up-to-date inventory records in the Warehouse and perform regular physical stock counts (cycle counts/audits).
	Inspect incoming/outgoing goods for damage, report discrepancies, and strictly enforce warehouse protocols and standards.


Requirements


	HND / BSc Degree in any relevant discipline
	Experience: 2+ years of experience in warehouse management, logistics, or inventory control.
	Proficiency with microsoft office suites
	Strong organizational skills, keen attention to detail, clear communication, and solid problem-solving skills.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
